digest.component_or_area: bugfix size gate / plan review escalation
propositions: A bug fix under 150 non-test lines should be escalated to plan review if the same file was touched by two or more bug-fix commits in the prior 7 days on the base branch
The repeat-fix predicate counts only commits whose trailer or subject resolves to a bug ticket, excluding merge commits, and evaluates per non-test path independently
A new module repeat_fix.py exports the predicate and its two thresholds (REPEAT_FIX_WINDOW_DAYS=7, REPEAT_FIX_MIN_PRIOR=2) for reuse and patchability in tests
The gate's attestation classification is only invoked when a diff is a bug AND either exceeds 150 non-test lines OR triggers the repeat-fix signal; under-floor non-repeat diffs skip all store reads
New coverage fields escalation_reason and repeat_fix_priors are added alongside flagged; the flagged field retains its original meaning (size threshold alone) to preserve the corpus pinning check
